eir_ollamh_court_position = {
	sort_order = 190
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = learning

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = storyteller
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/tavern.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	aptitude = {
		value = 25
		add = {
			value = learning
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		add = {
			value = diplomacy
			multiply = 1
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_diplomacy
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = lifestyle_poet
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = eir_court_trait_poet
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = eir_court_trait_gregarious
			}
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic
			}
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic
				has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic
			}
		}
		is_landed_or_landless_administrative_or_theocratic = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			is_adult = yes
			is_imprisoned = no
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = major_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = {
						has_treasury = no
					}
				}
				add = eir_court_salary_gold
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = {
						has_treasury = yes
					}
				}
				add = eir_court_salary_gold
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = eir_court_salary_prestige
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = eir_court_salary_gold
		}
		prestige = {
			value = eir_court_salary_prestige
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_prestige = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_prestige = 0.05
		}
		average = {
			monthly_prestige = 0.1
		}
		good = {
			monthly_prestige = 0.15
			owned_legend_spread_mult = 0.05
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_prestige = 0.2
			owned_legend_spread_mult = 0.1
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		stress_gain_mult = -0.15
		general_opinion = 5
	}

	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}

	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:employee = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:highest_available_aptitude > scope:employee_aptitude
				}
				add = -125
			}
			add = {
				value = scope:employee_aptitude
				multiply = 4
			}
		}
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
	}
}
